source.body:
# NIBIRU-051 — Texas Pilot RFQ Collection & Capital-Readiness Gate

Public coordination only. Created 2026-11-08. NO confidential parcel identifiers, private loan terms, bank details, investor identities, or offering materials.

## Current verified position
- BOXABL and Mesocore: original exploratory emails sent; no new replies found in latest connected Gmail check.
- ÖÖD House: partnership web form submission confirmed by user screenshot; no matching reply found.
- Canopy Engineering and Sandlot Engineering: tailored Gmail drafts remain saved; no sent receipts as of Sunday Nov. 8; weekday handoff remains active in the existing NEO Social Media Agent. Do NOT duplicate or bypass opt-out checks.
- No actual vendor cost proposals, financing commitments, site control or development permissions yet verified.

## Stage-appropriate quote requests
**Civil/entitlements (Canopy, Sandlot):** phased scope and fee estimate for desktop jurisdiction/zoning/ETJ review; floodplain and drainage screening; preliminary roads/access; survey/geotech dependencies; water/sewer service provider identification; electric/telecom feasibility; 1–4 home pilot concept and expansion constraints. Request deliverables, price basis (fixed fee/hourly), assumptions, milestones, documents needed and quote validity. Do not commission paid studies without approval.

**Manufacturers (BOXABL, ÖÖD, Mesocore):** written Texas-specific 1-unit and 4-unit proposals: model, habitable area, local code approvals, product price, freight/offloading, foundation/crew, utility tie-in, permit scope, third-party inspections, insurance, warranty, lead time, deposits, cancellation policy, and price expiry. Obtain manufacturer confirmation of eligibility and whether costs include shared roads and utility extensions.

## Comparable underwriting: only vendor evidence may populate actuals
Total development cost = controlled-site acquisition/closing + legal/title/survey + soils/environmental + engineering/entitlements/permits + shared roads/drainage + shared utility extensions + N × (unit + logistics/offloading + foundation + installation + utility hookups + inspections) + insurance + carrying/financing + tax/fees + evidence-supported contingency. Deduct items already included in vendor turnkey scope to avoid double-counting.

For each input retain: source document, date, currency, tax basis, scope inclusion/exclusion, confidence and quote expiration. Report three statuses **quoted**, **manufacturer advertised**, **unknown**; never invent specific missing costs.

## Capital stack workstreams (research, NOT awarded)
1. **Sponsor/owner equity** — evidence of committed, legally available funds required.
2. **Vendor-linked participation** — obtain written distribution, supply-credit, landowner/developer JV or revenue-share proposals with legal review; don't treat advertised partnership programs as financing commitments.
3. **Construction/development debt** — eligibility, site control, permitted scope, repayment and guaranty review; no loan applications without approval.
4. **Grant/public procurement avenues** — search the actual jurisdiction's current eligible programs and appropriations after project location, entity eligibility and project use are determined; no guaranteed grants or government Bitcoin-token purchases.
5. **Bitcoin payment/treasury infrastructure** — optional settlement only, subject to counterparty acceptance, AML/KYC, custody, tax, accounting and legal review. No crypto-token offering or return claims without separate counsel-led process.
6. **Donations and mission sponsorship** — specific authorized charitable/project use, truthful tax treatment, segregation of restricted funds, auditable receipts.

## First approval-ready procurement checkpoint
A) Verified pilot site jurisdiction and lawful control or landlord authorization.
B) Two written civil engineering scopes and at least two vendor delivered+installed proposals.
C) Independent legal/code feasibility and appropriately scoped construction operator.
D) Cash uses/sources covering deposits, infrastructure and contingency with no double-counting.
E) Named contracting/legal authority and written limitation on nonbinding outreach.
F) Record confidential quotes/terms in secure authenticated NIA-013 Deal Desk **only after** pending NEOpass, restricted database login, TLS, and audit tests are certified (#1343). Keep this public tracker nonconfidential.

## Next operation
During eligible Monday business hours: check Gmail for replies, sent items, bounces and opt-outs; send existing Canopy and Sandlot drafts at most two new contacts/business day, log actual receipts; gather replies and written fee proposals. No vendor or finance approvals yet.

Related #1344, #1354, #1365, #1368, #1377 and #1343.

NIBIRU-052 — Quote-intake / capital-stack acceptance ledger (2026-11-08, Sunday evening; public and non-binding).

CURRENT GMAIL EVIDENCE:
• No incoming supplier messages found in 14-day search from the five tracked corporate domains (BOXABL, Mesocore, ÖÖD, Canopy, Sandlot).
• Canopy and Sandlot drafts still exist; no SENT receipts for either. Do not claim they were dispatched. Existing NEO hourly agent is enabled. Weekday dispatch may begin only after renewed duplicate/opt-out checks; cap two new company emails per business day.
• No written engineering RFQ quotes or manufacturer-specific NEO project proposals in the checked messages.

STANDARD BID INTAKE REQUIREMENTS (a vendor is "quoted" only when received in a traceable, dated written reply/PDF):
- Quote ID, dated source, legal entity and business contact; scope and applicable location/jurisdiction.
- Unit/manufacturer model, proposed occupancy/use, code approvals and engineering plans.
- Pricing broken out as product, foundation/site works, freight, offload/crane, assembly, hookups, road/drainage/utility share, permits, professional fees, inspections, tax and maintenance/warranty.
- Lead times, price-expiration, deposits, cancellation terms, warranty, exclusions, and capacity for pilot 1x and 4x.
- Distinguish vendor-advertised price from contractual quote, developer estimate, and unknown. "Unknown" is not zero.
- Compare standard scope only after removing included turnkey components to avoid double count.

PILOT FINANCIAL ACCEPTANCE (no committed capital asserted):
Uses = site closing + professional/legal/entitlement + shared infrastructure + N*(installed housing and hookups) + inspections + taxes/insurance + contingency + financed carry. Sources = verified sponsor cash, documented development debt, executed vendor participation or independently confirmed eligible grants/sponsorship; every item tagged unverified/conditional/committed. Show funding gap and documented evidence. No bitcoin token purchase, investor solicitation, securities issuance or public loan promise inferred.

RELEASE BLOCKERS:
1) Neither engineering RFQ sent.
2) No vendor quotation or feasibility memo received.
3) No specific site jurisdiction/control verified in this public gate.
4) Authenticated NIA-013 private Deal Desk release remains blocked under #1343.
5) No contracting authority to incur study fees granted.

NEXT ACCEPTABLE REAL PROGRESS: verifiable Monday send receipts, first supplier replies, professional fee proposal, or independently verified site-control evidence; update tracker only when actual evidence appears.

NIBIRU-053 — Pilot capital-gap decision worksheet and engineering dispatch checkpoint (2026-11-08; nonconfidential).

### Dispatch evidence
- Connected Gmail still shows **no SENT receipts** for Canopy Engineering or Sandlot Engineering. Both prior original drafts are present (Canopy r-9210658896763243977, Sandlot r-7231564245662237964).
- No inbound messages found from BOXABL, Mesocore, ÖÖD House, Canopy, or Sandlot in the recent supplier-domain search. A lack of search matches is not proof that the recipient did not read an earlier message.
- Existing hourly agent remains enabled; do not falsely mark Sunday drafts as dispatched or promise a Monday send without later receipts.

### Sources-and-uses acceptance worksheet (pilot: N=1 or 4; do NOT treat published product costs as total development cost)
**USES** (each line: evidenced amount or *unknown*): land closing and title; survey/geotech; engineering and entitlements; permits; shared roads/drainage; shared water/wastewater; shared power/telecom; per-unit product; freight/offloading; foundation; assembly/inspection; tax and insurance; predevelopment/legal; appropriate contingency; carrying costs.
**SOURCES** (each line: verified committed, conditional, or unverified): approved sponsor cash; landlord contribution; executed developer JV/vender funding; underwritten construction financing; legally confirmed grant award; documented project donation.
**GAP** = total verified/estimated USES minus enforceable/available SOURCES. A negative result is not funding surplus unless all use categories and contingencies have defensible estimates.
**Exposure limits**: no developer deposits or paid feasibility contracts unless funding and authority confirmed; vendor revenue share is not committed capital without agreed written terms.
**Scenario baselines**: BOXABL Studio product-only 1× $60k, 4× $240k; manufacturer turnkey starting 1× $150k, 4× $600k; ÖÖD Signature listed 1× $139,900, 4× $559,600 (manufacturer figures only; not quote-equivalent, site infrastructure and exclusions unknown). Never combine or count more than one housing option in the same scenario.

### Independent readiness decisions
1. Engineering RFQs: pass only after verified corporate Gmail sent receipts and at least one scope response.
2. Budget quote quality: pass only with 2 comparable site-specific manufacturer quotes + 1 qualified civil fee estimate.
3. Site eligibility: pass only with verified permission/site-control and jurisdiction-specific code, utilities and floodplain screen.
4. Capital: pass only with written evidence for availability of funds, a minimum contingency appropriate to engineered risk, and independently reviewed legal and lender terms.
5. Security: private documents withheld from public repository until NIA-013 security release accepted (#1343).

### Immediate action on first eligible business day
Recheck drafts, SENT, replies, opt-outs and business-hour eligibility; existing outreach agent may send at most two distinct supplier introductions and must record actual receipts. Do not create duplicate fresh drafts or send on Sunday.

This update extends issue #1379; sourcing #1344 and feasibility #1365 remain canonical.

NIBIRU-054 — Fundable pilot go/no-go control, verified 2026-11-08 evening (public, non-binding).

**Outreach facts:** Gmail search still shows no SENT receipts for engineering contacts Canopy and Sandlot; both original Gmail drafts remain intact. No matching supplier replies from BOXABL, Mesocore, ÖÖD, Canopy, or Sandlot in the recent-domain search. NEO Social Media Agent remains enabled with NIBIRU-046 weekday dispatch instructions. Never record a draft as an executed contact.

**Decision-ready 1-vs-4 unit vendor bid comparison — acceptance fields**
- Price basis: quoted / advertised / unknown, currency, date, expiration, legal seller
- Local approval: Texas legal dwelling classification, engineered plans, local permit route, certifications
- Delivery: factory lead time, freight route, unloading/crane, installer availability
- Cost separation: quoted unit price, included site/foundation, hookups, offsite/shared infrastructure, sales tax, fees, contingency
- Commercial terms: deposit/refund, warranty, insurance, milestone payments, construction risk allocation
- Developer fit: regional capacity and multi-phase expansion, option for nonbinding pilot participation
- Evidence: actual vendor PDF/email quote, site-specific jurisdiction, civil fee proposal, quote validity

**Capital readiness test (not passed):** (1) verify parcel/site legal control and intended use; (2) engineering feasibility and utilities/road access; (3) two comparable actual housing proposals; (4) one written civil fee estimate and cost exclusions; (5) validated total uses including shared infrastructure + contingency; (6) sponsor funding or signed financing evidence. Unknown amounts remain unknown, not zero. No fundable gap can be responsibly calculated now.

**Next actionable milestone:** Monday business-hours send *the existing two drafts* only after checking SENT, INBOX, opt-outs and recipient applicability; capture Gmail send IDs. Upon first replies, request fee/scope PDFs, do not agree to paid work, and update supplier qualification status accordingly. Confidential terms belong in authenticated Deal Desk after its release gate, not public GitHub.

Do not create another redundant gate issue; maintain canonical RFQ/capital task #1379, vendor tracker #1344 and security blocker #1343.
